description: Paper-trades Polymarket 'Up or Down' crypto markets. For each in-progress window it computes the fair probability of 'Up' from live exchange prices (the market settles on Chainlink's time-weighted average over the window, so the model prices an average, not a closing price). It buys the Up or Down share only when that fair probability exceeds the ask price plus Polymarket's taker fee by a margin, sizes the bet by a fraction of the Kelly criterion, and holds to settlement. Inspired by the 'signal vs posted odds' description in the user's reference posts; rules chosen before any live result.

model.price_source: Coinbase Exchange public API, 1-minute candles + ticker (proxy for Chainlink)
model.note: Settles Up if Chainlink TWAP over the window >= price at the window start. Fair P(Up) = Phi((S_t - K') / (S_t * sigma * sqrt(r/3))) with K' = (S0 - e*A)/(1-e), A = realized average so far, e = elapsed fraction, r = minutes remaining. The basis buffer shifts the threshold against each trade to allow for Coinbase-vs-Chainlink differences; probabilities are capped at 97% because the model can't be more certain than its data.

entry.note: edge = fair probability - (ask + taker fee per share). Only buys when the edge is at least 5 cents per $1 of payout.

fees.formula: fee per share = rate * p * (1 - p) (Polymarket docs, crypto category)

sizing.note: quarter-Kelly for a binary paying $1: f = 0.25 * (q - c) / (1 - c), capped at 10% of equity per market and 60% total open exposure

risk.note: a 30% drawdown from peak stops new bets for the rest of the experiment

execution.fills: walk the live order book asks, only levels that still clear the edge threshold; decision and book read in the same run
execution.settlement: Polymarket's official resolution (outcomePrices) after the window ends
